purpose: Prevent a later Git commit from inheriting an immutable action receipt issued for an earlier runtime.
rules: receipt.commit_sha MUST equal exact-current runtime commit_sha
receipt action_id MUST equal the action being reconciled
a later documentation-only commit does NOT inherit an earlier action receipt
a receipt MUST NOT be rewritten to follow a later commit
a new runtime commit requires a fresh action/evidence receipt if the action is to be executed again
repository HEAD alone is not runtime proof
runtime evidence has priority over repository projection
mismatch => DENY and no transport probe
DENY receipt may document the mismatch but cannot satisfy the original action receipt gate
